import asyncio
# CASE py_inorder_typed expect=pass
async def in_order[T](items: list[T], step, *, reason: str) -> None:
    for item in items:
        await step(item)
# CASE py_mwc_typed expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items: list[T], width: int, operation) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))
# CASE py_call_reason expect=pass
async def migrate(rows, save):
    await in_order(rows, save, reason="Each update reads the row the previous step wrote")
